title: FBI Photo B005
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.image_type: black-and-white video or targeting-display frame with overlay
pages.description: A grainy grayscale image resembling a surveillance or targeting camera view with a graduated reticle overlay. A white crosshair with a horizontal and vertical scale crosses near the center; the horizontal axis is marked with numbers 15, 10, 5, 0, 5, 10, 15 and tick marks. The background is a noisy gray gradient, darker at the top and lighter in the middle. A solid black bar runs across the top. Several black rectangular redaction blocks are placed symmetrically on the left and right sides at multiple vertical levels, some with faint gray extensions. A faint rounded dark shape appears near the bottom center. White timestamp text appears in the lower-left corner.
